English(en): An abandoned house with its door open. Shoes sit side by side at the entrance.
Korean(ko): 문이 열린 폐가. 현관에 신발이 나란히 놓여 있다.

English(en): Took food and cloth scraps from the drawers.
Korean(ko): 서랍 속에서 식량과 천 조각을 챙겼다.

English(en): A rotten floorboard gave way. Someone got hurt.
The basement shelves still held food and liquor.
Korean(ko): 지하 선반에 식량과 술이 남아 있었다.

English(en): The shoes at the door weighed on someone.
Korean(ko): 현관의 신발이 자꾸 눈에 걸려 누군가 마음이 무거웠다.

English(en): The ground has sunk on one side. Someone buried something here.
Korean(ko): 땅이 한쪽만 푹 꺼져 있다. 누군가 묻은 흔적이다.

English(en): Whatever was buried kept nagging at someone.
A stream runs nearby. The water is loud.
Slipped on moss. Someone got hurt.
The cold water eased the tiredness.
The loud water kept someone awake.
Wire hangs at the pond's edge where a fishing rod should be.
Korean(ko): 연못 가장자리에 낚싯대 대신 철사가 걸려 있다.

English(en): Waited a long time. No bites.
Picked up usable cloth by the water.
Sank into the mud. Someone got hurt.
Thoughts of fishing made someone hungry.
Small tracks lead into the brush.
Caught a rabbit in the brush.
Korean(ko): 덤불 속에서 토끼 한 마리를 잡았다.

English(en): The snare came up empty. Lost the rope.
The tracks stayed on someone's mind.
There's a whole day to work on the van.
Korean(ko): 하루 종일 차체를 만질 수 있다.

English(en): Went over every corner with the tools.
The van's rattling nagged at someone all day.
Korean(ko): 쉬는 내내 차체 삐걱대는 소리가 귀에 걸렸다.

English(en): The wheel nuts have come loose.
The nuts spun loose and made it worse.
Tightened every nut with the tool.
The wheel noise kept bothering someone.
Water leaks from the roof. The steady drip is almost soothing.
Korean(ko): 지붕에서 물이 샌다. 빗방울 소리가 규칙적이라 잠이 온다.

English(en): Caught the drips in a bowl.
Slept through the leak. The roof got a little worse.
Korean(ko): 물이 새는 채로 잤다. 천장이 조금 더 상했다.

English(en): Thick grease has caked the engine bay.
Wiped the grease off. The engine runs better.
Korean(ko): 기름때를 닦아 내니 엔진이 한결 낫다.

English(en): The engine-bay smell clung to someone.
Laundry hung out. It takes three days to dry.
Korean(ko): 빨래를 널었다. 마르는 데 사흘 걸린다.

English(en): A bucket of water and a tarp. Hardly a shower.
Korean(ko): 물 한 통과 천막 하나. 샤워라 부르기엔 거창하다.

English(en): Today's menu is the same as yesterday's. Nobody has the energy to complain.
Korean(ko): 오늘 메뉴는 어제와 같다. 불만을 말할 힘이 없다.

English(en): Same taste as yesterday. At least it filled the stomach.
Korean(ko): 어제와 같은 맛이었다. 그래도 배는 찼다.

English(en): A full belly brought some strength.
Skipped a meal and saved food. Someone lost strength.
Korean(ko): 한 끼를 걸러 식량을 아꼈다. 누군가 기운이 빠졌다.

English(en): Someone is writing in a diary. Today's line: "Survived."
Korean(ko): 누군가 일기를 쓴다. 오늘의 한 줄: "살았다."

English(en): Added a line each. Nerves settled.
A map fragment was tucked between the pages.
Korean(ko): 일기 사이에 지도 조각이 끼워져 있었다.

English(en): Got caught. A fight broke out and someone got hurt.
The diary kept catching someone's eye.
Deciding who takes the first watch. Nobody raises a hand.
Korean(ko): 첫 불침번을 누가 설지 정한다. 아무도 손을 들지 않는다.

English(en): Dozed off and some food went missing.
Someone got hurt in the night.
Planted a flare and slept easy.
Korean(ko): 조명탄을 세워 두고 마음 놓고 잤다.

English(en): Someone knocks on the door. Nobody is outside.
Korean(ko): 누군가 문을 두드린다. 문 밖에 아무도 없다.

English(en): The knocking wouldn't stop. Someone panicked and got hurt.
Korean(ko): 두드림이 멈추지 않았다. 누군가 놀라 다쳤다.

English(en): Someone had left gold at the door.
Korean(ko): 문 앞에 누가 두고 간 골드가 있었다.

English(en): Something lunged the moment the door opened.
The flare light made the knocking stop.
Something is sniffing around on the roof.
Korean(ko): 지붕 위에서 무언가 냄새를 맡는 소리가 난다.

English(en): The roof was clawed and someone was badly hurt.
The smell leaked out. Food went missing.
The smoke spooked it. The roof went quiet.
A pat on the back and they fell back asleep.
The soothing voices carried outside. Someone got hurt.
Korean(ko): 달래는 소리가 밖으로 새 나갔다. 누군가 다쳤다.

English(en): Lost sleep. Someone is worn out.
Something rustles in the cargo area. Doesn't sound like a rat.
Korean(ko): 짐칸에서 부스럭 소리가 난다. 쥐가 아닌 것 같다.

English(en): Chased it off and found gold on the floor.
It got away with some food. Someone got hurt.
Food went missing while we looked away.
A flashlight beam sways in the distance. Someone's out there.
Found out. Food taken and someone hurt.
The light came over and shared food.
Another group of survivors is camped nearby. Both sides pretend not to notice.
Korean(ko): 근처에 다른 생존자가 야영 중이다. 서로 모른 척한다.

English(en): A short hello, then a small swap.
They paid us back for the food.
All the side-eyeing wore someone out.
An old man tells a story by the fire. Nobody knows how it ends.
Korean(ko): 노인이 불가에서 이야기를 한다. 끝을 아는 사람은 없다.

English(en): By the end, nerves had settled.
The old man handed over a map fragment.
He dozed off. Only the food was gone.
The story nagged at someone all night.
A field lies beyond the barbed wire. The crops are still standing.
Korean(ko): 철조망 너머에 밭이 보인다. 작물이 아직 서 있다.

English(en): Cut the wire and harvested the crops.
Caught on the wire. Someone got hurt.
An entrance is buried in the ground. The dirt over it is fresh.
Korean(ko): 땅에 묻힌 입구가 보인다. 흙을 덮은 흔적이 새롭다.

English(en): The cellar was already picked over. Only some food was left.
Korean(ko): 지하실은 이미 털려 있었다. 식량만 남았다.

English(en): Pulled some food out of a gap.
Banged a hand on a stone.
The buried entrance gnawed at someone.
The wall is covered in graffiti. The last line reads: "The north is a lie."
Korean(ko): 벽에 낙서가 가득하다. 마지막 줄: "북쪽은 거짓말이다."

English(en): Found a map fragment scrawled among the graffiti.
Korean(ko): 낙서 틈에 그려진 지도 조각을 찾았다.

English(en): Cut a hand scrubbing the wall.
The last line stuck in someone's head.
A broken radio. Only the antenna is intact.
Korean(ko): 고장 난 라디오 하나. 안테나만 멀쩡하다.

English(en): It crackled back to life as a working radio.
Broke it for good. Only scrap salvaged.
The static kept echoing in someone's ears.
Gathered a pile of usable branches.
Pricked by splinters. Someone got hurt.
Chopped a good armful with the axe.
The branches stayed on someone's mind.
A tent stands empty. The sleeping bag still seems warm.
Korean(ko): 텐트가 쳐진 채 비어 있다. 침낭은 아직 따뜻한 것 같다.

English(en): Found cloth and food beside the sleeping bag.
Someone came back and chased us off. Someone got hurt.
Waiting in the cold left someone sick.
Thoughts of the tent kept someone up.
Korean(ko): 텐트 생각에 누군가 잠이 오지 않았다.

English(en): Thinking of taking a lap around the area.
Picked up some gold close by.
Found a good haul of gold far out.
Chased by something far out. Someone got hurt.
From a tall tree you could see the surroundings.
Korean(ko): 높은 나무 위에서 주변이 보일 것 같다.

English(en): Spotted something useful from the treetop.
Korean(ko): 나무 위에서 쓸 만한 걸 찾았다.

English(en): A branch snapped and someone fell.
Climbed safely on the rope and scanned the area.
The tall tree kept drawing someone's eye.
A cat has slipped into the cargo area. It's after the food.
Korean(ko): 고양이 한 마리가 짐칸에 들어갔다. 목적은 식량이다.

English(en): The cat ran off with some food.
The cat settled in a lap and purred.
The cat's stare followed someone around.
The rain has stopped. Every puddle holds a piece of sky.
Slipped on wet ground. Someone got hurt.
Splashed in the puddles and laughed.
Someone's vegetable patch. The owner is gone and half of it is weeds.
Korean(ko): 누군가 가꾸던 텃밭. 주인은 없고 잡초가 반이다.

English(en): Found edible things under the weeds.
Korean(ko): 잡초 밑에서 먹을 만한 걸 찾았다.

English(en): Bitten by bugs. Someone got hurt.
Dug crops out of the soil.
Thoughts of the garden's owner weighed on someone.
